rationale: Round 2 added an external cost-savings assessment and clarified the trade-offs, but the core conflict remains unresolved: capital and management still want closures as a credible structural option, while labour, the works council, and the state maintain hard red lines against closures and compulsory redundancies. Positions have hardened, yet the exact threshold for equivalent non-closure savings has not been tested against site-specific numbers, so further rounds could still change the bargaining space.
